pins: Nested objects (androidBuild), arrays of strings (supportedAbis, suspiciousFilePaths, languages) and arrays of numbers (openReverseEngineeringPorts) cross the envelope with their JSON types intact — no stringified numbers, no comma-joined arrays, no flattened nesting.
notes: Bridge marshalling is the usual place this breaks: a native map that stringifies numbers still 'works' until a consumer compares types.
